text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Tuesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Angolan president Jose Eduardo dos Santos began a 48 hour visit to Spain on Monday to reinforce bilateral ties between both countries.
- One of the founder members of Angola's ruling MPLA party, Carlos Rocha Dilolwa, who opposed Portuguese colonialism, died at his home on Monday after a long illness.

- The 1996/97 agricultural year was launched in Angola's Huila province which has a farming capacity of over 100,000 hectares of land. This year just 40,000 ha was cultivated due to a lack of seeds and farming tools.
